entries.zh: 保护；护卫（如上帝护佑人、军队护城）
entries.en: to protect, guard; to defend (as God protects, as the militia defends the city)

entries.zh: 庇祐；护佑、保佑
entries.en: to bless and protect, shelter

entries.zh: 为；为助、扶助、施恩庇护
entries.en: to do/make for; to help, favor, befriend
entries.notes: 西语 ayudar·amparar·faborecer 与单字「为」并置，17 世纪或以「为」训助，义项归属有推断成分。

entries.zh: 协力；合力强助
entries.en: to join forces, help with combined strength
entries.notes: 西语含缩写（aser fuerza una…，或 una misma cosa），展开有推断成分。

entries.zh: 协力同心；同心合力相助
entries.en: to work with one heart and joint strength; to help in concert

entries.zh: 护；护卫、救护
entries.en: to protect, shield

entries.zh: 帮；帮衬做事之人、帮工
entries.en: to help one who works; to assist (an artisan/official at his trade)

entries.zh: 帮贴；众人出钱共同贴补、集资接济
entries.en: to help jointly with money, to chip in, subsidize
entries.notes: 闽南栏第二音节 T99 污损难辨，靠西语与汉字栏定释。

entries.zh: 救；救助、搭救
entries.en: to save, rescue, deliver

entries.zh: 救济；施舍周济
entries.en: to relieve with alms, give charity

entries.zh: 救护；护救、救助
entries.en: to rescue and protect

entries.zh: 救急；济急、救人之急需
entries.en: to help in necessity, emergency relief

entries.zh: 救应；应召赴援、接应救助
entries.en: to go to the rescue when called, to reinforce

entries.zh: 来救／求救（原件二字存疑）；救援、搭救
entries.en: to come to the rescue; to save, succour
entries.notes: 封存件标注汉字首字[疑:来/求]，二字取何不定，语义均指向救援。

entries.zh: 卫；卫护、保卫
entries.en: to guard, protect, defend

entries.zh: 资；资给、资助
entries.en: to supply, aid with means

entries.zh: 资身；资给其身、接济某人生计
entries.en: to support someone, supply a person's needs

entries.zh: 赞；襄助、赞助（助其营为）
entries.en: to assist, aid in an undertaking (hu: an exclamation or tail noted in the source)
entries.notes: 西语尾注「hu」含义不明，存疑附记。

entries.zh: 赞言；进言相助、代为说情
entries.en: to help by interceding, speak on someone's behalf

entries.zh: 赞口；口头上相助、说好话帮衬
entries.en: to help with words, to speak for someone

entries.zh: 赞成；助其成事、从中说合成事
entries.en: to help bring about, second a matter (17c sense: assist to accomplishment)

entries.zh: 占；占助／基督教会之助（西语缩写残，释义存疑）
entries.en: to help of the grace of Christian (expanded from abbreviation; uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语缩写「ayudara n del gr stinien」残损难展开，仅按残文猜测。

entries.zh: 保庇；神明庇护、护佑圣者
entries.en: God's protection; to shield (as God shields the saints)

entries.zh: 保祐（祐／佑存疑）；如神明般保佑
entries.en: to bless and protect as God does
entries.notes: 封存件标注第二字[疑:祐/佑]，且闽南栏三音节对官话栏两音节，音节对应有出入。
